purpose: Teach: 中曽根/ドール/ジョーンズ/サード/ハリス/菅/内藤/ダニエル

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、中曽根時代の警察制度改革の文献を、警察、参照されますね
lines.en: You've been consulting literature on police system reforms from the Nakasone era, I understand.
lines.style: Steady, collaborative tone. Light recognition on each confirmation. Not probing—acknowledging what he already knows the department handles. Calm, almost administrative rhythm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、輸入会社ドール関連の事案も対応されますね
lines.en: And you're coordinating with the import company case involving Dole as well, correct?
lines.style: Same measured pace. Slight upward lift at the end—asking for confirmation rather than making an assertion. Respectful distance, genuinely curious about scope.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、海外捜査機関ジョーンズ氏とも連絡されますね
lines.en: You're also in contact with overseas investigative officer Jones, I believe.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact acknowledgment. No surprise in the voice. Building the picture of their reach and coordination. Neutral, professional warmth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、サード・パーティ監査の活用も視野に入れられますね
lines.en: Third-party audits are something you're considering as part of your approach, then.
lines.style: Thoughtful pacing. Slight pause before the statement—processing the sophistication of the strategy. Recognition without flattery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、米国捜査官ハリス氏と情報共有されますね
lines.en: And you're sharing information with U.S. investigator Harris as well.
lines.style: Continuing the same thread. Light confirmation. The implication is clear—thorough, coordinated work. No need to emphasize.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地検の菅検事と連携されますね
lines.en: You're coordinating with Prosecutor Suga from the District Prosecutor's Office.
lines.style: Factual statement delivered gently. Acknowledges the significance of that connection without making it dramatic. Professional respect underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人内藤氏から事情を、警察、丁寧に聴かれますね
lines.en: I understand you're listening carefully to witness Naito's account of events.
lines.style: Soft emphasis on 'carefully'—recognition that this step matters. Slow, deliberate delivery. Checking in on the human element of the investigation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、海外捜査官ダニエル氏との通訳を、警察、ご手配されますね
lines.en: You've arranged for interpreters to work with overseas investigator Daniel, then.
lines.style: Concluding statement, slightly warmer. Recognition of the logistical care taken. Respectful, almost admiring. Slight ease in the final word—this is well-managed.
